entries.femaleVariant: Pair Seven moved up twelve hours. Timestamp starts two minutes after the Kabuki relay went dark.
entries.maleVariant: Pair Seven moved up twelve hours. Timestamp starts two minutes after the Kabuki relay went dark.

entries.femaleVariant: Then Cinder did not interrupt the route. She made it show its hand.
entries.maleVariant: Then Cinder did not interrupt the route. She made it show its hand.

entries.femaleVariant: Freight packaging full of neural suppressants.
entries.maleVariant: Freight packaging full of neural suppressants.

entries.femaleVariant: They damp memory rejection. Enough keeps the foreign fragments quiet. Too much makes the courier unable to recognize their own.
entries.maleVariant: They damp memory rejection. Enough keeps the foreign fragments quiet. Too much makes the courier unable to recognize their own.

entries.femaleVariant: Restraints, bite guard, biomonitor. No sedative line.
entries.maleVariant: Restraints, bite guard, biomonitor. No sedative line.

entries.femaleVariant: They keep the couriers conscious. A sleeping brain cannot confirm the graft still feels real.
entries.maleVariant: They keep the couriers conscious. A sleeping brain cannot confirm the graft still feels real.

entries.femaleVariant: Beacon is seated. Controller thinks it belongs there.
entries.maleVariant: Beacon is seated. Controller thinks it belongs there.

entries.femaleVariant: Good. I only need one valid route heartbeat.
entries.maleVariant: Good. I only need one valid route heartbeat.

entries.femaleVariant: Found Zero-Seven-B. Box truck, refrigerated registry, heading for an interchange in Northside.
entries.maleVariant: Found Zero-Seven-B. Box truck, refrigerated registry, heading for an interchange in Northside.

entries.femaleVariant: And Zero-Seven-A just resolved. I have Mara's clinic.
entries.maleVariant: And Zero-Seven-A just resolved. I have Mara's clinic.

entries.femaleVariant: The beacon authenticated without an alarm. Black Lantern still believes Pair Seven is on schedule.
entries.maleVariant: The beacon authenticated without an alarm. Black Lantern still believes Pair Seven is on schedule.

entries.femaleVariant: Clean enough to make me jealous. I try that and a door asks for three references.
entries.maleVariant: Clean enough to make me jealous. I try that and a door asks for three references.

entries.femaleVariant: Yard raised an intrusion flag. The beacon is still transmitting, but the clinic will know somebody touched the route.
entries.maleVariant: Yard raised an intrusion flag. The beacon is still transmitting, but the clinic will know somebody touched the route.

entries.femaleVariant: Freight crew is shouting into every channel they own. Clinic will be awake. Probably armed. Definitely rude.
entries.maleVariant: Freight crew is shouting into every channel they own. Clinic will be awake. Probably armed. Definitely rude.

entries.femaleVariant: Sending Mara's location now. The jammer around her implant is stronger than the clinic walls. Disable it before you search for her.
entries.maleVariant: Sending Mara's location now. The jammer around her implant is stronger than the clinic walls. Disable it before you search for her.
